Messages.Body:
Hi,

I am currently reading the Rulebook (section 10) and it does not
seem clear to me : what are the sects ?
Only Sabbat and Camarilla ?
or
Sabbat, Camarilla, and Independant ?
or
Sabbat, Camarilla, Anarchs and Independant ?
(but Anarchs are Independant, so...)

If someone can help...
Thanx !

Messages.Author: John P.
Messages.Body:
"- baron2ni -" <dge...@noos.fr> wrote in message news:40713139$0$22831$79c1...@nan-newsreader-02.noos.net...


Sects:
Camarilla, Sabbat, Independant

There are three sects - every vampire belongs to exactly one sect

Anarchs are not a sect. See the rulebook section on anarchs where
is says: "becoming an anarch changes a vampire's sect to Independant"

-JTP

Messages.Author: Curevei
Messages.Body:
> I am currently reading the Rulebook (section 10) and it does not
>seem clear to me : what are the sects ?

Just because under Independents it says:

"Other clans are not aligned with either sect; they are called Independent."

I can't imagine how that would confuse anyone. It is only in the Anarchs
section where it says Independent is a sect. Something should probably be
rewritten.
